policy_boundary: Retention decisions are inherited from the approved capacity contract. Any destructive implementation requires a separately reviewed, resumable job with export verification and domain-integrity checks.

families.retention: active lifetime plus 7 years after archive
families.intervention: archive an entire closed project graph to a checksummed immutable export before batched deletion
families.integrity_requirement: project, iteration, task, dependency, external-link, request-source, and milestone references reconcile before and after archive

families.intervention: time-window archive with checksummed row counts, followed by primary-key-bounded purge
families.integrity_requirement: no retained event may reference a missing retained task

families.intervention: archive terminal runs, their events, and terminal assignments as one referential unit before batched purge
families.integrity_requirement: active or nonterminal runs, claims, assignments, and their events are never eligible

families.selector: all deliveries for an event are completed and older than cutoff
families.intervention: delete deliveries in bounded event groups, then delete unreferenced events
families.integrity_requirement: pending, leased, retryable, or partially failed event groups are never eligible

families.selector: all deliveries for an event are terminal and the newest terminal timestamp is older than cutoff
families.intervention: checksummed failure archive followed by bounded event-group purge
families.integrity_requirement: failure payload and attempt history remain complete in the archive

families.selector: revoked or expired and older than cutoff
families.intervention: primary-key-bounded purge after saved-view ownership has been detached or retained by policy
families.integrity_requirement: active and nearly-expired browser identities are never eligible

families.intervention: purge only receipts whose command target and related execution history are terminal beyond the same cutoff
families.integrity_requirement: no replay key within the supported retry or audit window may be removed

families.intervention: archive immutable assessment inputs and result digests before bounded purge
families.integrity_requirement: the latest assessment for every retained task is retained

families.retention: active lifetime plus 7 years after project archive
families.intervention: included in the project graph archive
families.integrity_requirement: updates retain author, ordering, and project linkage

families.intervention: move raw and signed reports to immutable artifact storage with checksum manifests
families.integrity_requirement: signed reports retain every referenced raw artifact for the full window

families.intervention: backup-system expiry only after a newer restore chain has passed verification
families.integrity_requirement: the declared RPO window always has a complete base-backup and WAL chain

capacity_trigger.evaluation: The qualification collector projects database, table, index, and WAL growth from the measured steady, burst, and eight-hour soak deltas.
capacity_trigger.fail_closed_action: If projected utilization reaches 70 percent inside 12 months, DBM-QUAL-001 remains incomplete until an online expansion or the selected archive, partition, or purge mechanism is implemented and exercised under load.

execution_guards.reason: The certified baseline is expected to retain at least 12 months of headroom. No destructive retention worker is authorized until measured evidence crosses the trigger and its implementation receives a separate review.
required_before_first_purge: checksummed export where decision includes archive
load-test comparison showing no SLO regression
